Remember Craig Robinson as Darryl from *The Office*? Houston, he's hitting the stage at the Improv this June. Known for mixing comedy with music, Craig brings his unique style and sharp social commentary live. Expect laughs, surprises, and maybe a tune or two. Catch him after his recent weight loss journey, it's like seeing a new side of an old friend.

Houston, catch Mojo Brookzz, the guy who lit up "Wild 'N Out," live on stage. 🎤 Known for his high-energy, story-driven sets, Mojo blends sharp observations with hilarious tales about family and dating. He’s packed theaters nationwide, and now it's your turn to see why. Don't miss the chance to laugh with a true talent straight from Chicago.
